items.title: Get a Chef Uniform and a Warturkey Mount in November 2026 Trading Post
items.summary: Here's everything in the November 2026 Trading Post, which contains two chef uniforms and a Warturkey mount!

items.title: Could the WoW: Forever Podcast be Teasing a Secret New Weapon?
items.summary: A mysterious message on the latest WoW: Forever podcast board has players decoding Darnassian and speculating about what Blizzard could be hinting at.

items.title: Repeatable Quest Experience Exploit Fixed for WoW: Forever Launch
items.summary: Players discovered a repeatable Alliance-only quest that continuously gave XP, but Blizzard has fixed the quest for Forever's launch - don't plan to level with it!

items.title: New Drust-Themed Hearthstone Available from Talebound
items.summary: A brand-new Hearthstone is available from Talebound, and we've datamined its animation!

items.title: Massive Talent Tree Changes to Druids and Paladins - Class Tuning for WoW: Forever
items.summary: Druids and Paladins have some massive talent tree changes, with many others getting class tuning changes ahead of WoW: Forever's launch on November 4th!

items.title: Over 8 Million Characters Were Created in the WoW: Forever Beta
items.summary: Blizzard has released some statistics about the WoW: Forever Beta, and over 8 million characters were created!

items.title: November Traveler's Log Bonus Reward - Hot Motocross Bunmover 4600 Mount
items.summary: Blizzard has announced the November Traveler's Log bonus reward, the Motocross Bunmover 4600!

items.title: WoW Weekly Recap - WoW: Forever, Talebound Demo, New Shop Decor Packs
items.summary: Blizzard has posted this week's WoW weekly recap, which includes WoW: Forever launching next week, the Talebound Demo starting today, and new shop decor packs.

items.title: Blizzard Addresses Day and Night Cycle Issues for Oceanic Players in WoW: Forever
items.summary: In the latest episode of the WoW: Forever Podcast, Blizzard has addressed Day and Night cycle issues for Oceanic Players in WoW: Forever.

items.title: Returning to Dornogal - Patch 12.1.7 Campaign Playthrough (Story Spoilers)
items.summary: In patch 12.1.7, players depart Silvermoon and return to Dornogal in pursuit of Xal'atath! Here, we showcase the story of this prologue chapter for patch 12.2.

items.title: Talebound End-Game Player Power Rewards - Venomstones, Bonus Rolls, Experience Potions
items.summary: Talebound has many rewards, including Venomstones, Bonus Rolls, Mythic raid loot, and experience potions!

items.title: Two New Housing Exterior Customizations Discovered on 12.1.7 PTR
items.summary: In the latest Patch 12.1.7 PTR build, items to learn two new housing exterior customization options have been discovered!

items.title: Talebound Awards Two Pieces of Mythic Venomous Abyss Loot
items.summary: Players who complete two new achievements in Talebound will obtain two pieces of Mythic Venomous Abyss loot!

items.title: Everything You Need to Know for WoW: Forever's Global Launch
items.summary: Blizzard has summarized everything you need to know for WoW: Forever's Global launch on November 4th.

items.title: Forced World Refreshes Will Be Significantly Reduced for WoW: Forever
items.summary: On WoW: Forever's launch, joining a group won't automatically phase you anymore, and forced layer refreshes shouldn't happen as often.

items.title: Return to Azeroth Recap for World of Warcraft: Forever
items.summary: Blizzard reminds players about what awaits them when they return to Azeroth on November 4th for World of Warcraft: Forever.

items.title: Patch 12.1.7 PTR Development Notes - Talebound Demo Available Tomorrow
items.summary: Blizzard has posted 12.1.7 PTR development notes for today, which reminds players that the Talebound Demo is available tomorrow!

items.title: Blizzard Working on Top Layering Issues in WoW: Forever
items.summary: In the latest episode of the WoW: Forever Podcast, Blizzard has addressed that they are working on the most noticeable layer issues players saw on the Beta.

items.title: The WoW: Forever Podcast Episode 6 Now Available - Tech and Community Building
items.summary: The 6th episode of the WoW: Forever podcast is now live and this week they're talking about Tech and community building!

items.title: WoW: Forever is Aiming for a 4-Month Patch Cadence
items.summary: In an interview with IGN, Kris Zierhut announced that they are looking at a 4-month patch cadence for WoW: Forever.

items.title: Patch Cadence, Future Locations, Respeccing - IGN Interview on WoW: Forever
items.summary: IGN interviewed Blizzard on WoW: Forever and discussed the patch cadence, locations for future patches, respeccing, and a lot more!

items.title: After 2 Weeks, Over 200k Players Have Defeated Tier 11 Kindo'jan Solo
items.summary: The Delve Hall of Fame is now closed, and over 200k players have defeated Tier 11 Kindo'jan solo and earned the achievement Let Me Solo Him!

items.title: New Class and Item Tuning on WoW: Forever - Hunter Changes
items.summary: With name reservations now live in WoW: Forever, there are some tuning changes for Hunters and an Alchemy potion.

items.title: Retail Team Discussing Lighting and Water Improvements from WoW: Forever
items.summary: In an interview with IGN, Kris Zierhut confirms that the Retail WoW team has been discussing many of the lightning and water improvements from WoW: Forever.

items.title: New Player’s Starter Guide for World of Warcraft: Forever
items.summary: Blizzard has released a new player's starter guide for World of Warcraft: Forever!

items.title: Planet Azeroth: Episode 1 ft. Bill Bailey
items.summary: Learn more about wolves, boars and the Barrens Chat in the new YouTube video series, Planet Azeroth, narrated by Bill Bailey.

items.title: New Cabin-Themed Shop Decor Discovered in Patch 12.1.7
items.summary: New decor sourced from the shop has been discovered on the 12.1.7 PTR, and it looks to be cozy, winter cabin-themed.

items.title: Warlords of Draenor Timewalking Week Now Live
items.summary: Warlords of Draenor Timewalking is now live for the week!

items.title: Name Reservations Included Overly Restrictive Name Check But Fix Incoming
items.summary: Blizzard announced that today's WoW: Forever name reservations had an overly restrictive name check, but a fix for this is coming with realm restarts.

items.title: Class Tuning and Bug Fixes - Patch 12.1.5 Hotfixes for October 27th
items.summary: Blizzard has posted hotfixes for today, which includes class tuning and fixing a bug where Labyrinth scenarios were not granting Vault credit.

items.title: Myth 2/6 Piece of Loot Now Available from Labyrinths
items.summary: The first piece of Myth 2/6 loot is available in Labyrinths, making it easier to gear up your characters!

items.title: Blizzard Takes Action Against RMT on Retail WoW - Gold Transactions Should Be Direct
items.summary: Blizzard has taken action against RMT on Retail WoW, reminding players that Gold Transactions should be direct from buyer to seller.

items.title: Players Upset Latest Housing Bundles Breaks Stated Philosophy on Hearthsteel
items.summary: Many players are upset that the recent Grimtide housing bundle appears to break Blizzard's stated philosophy and guiding principles for real-money housing items.

items.title: Blizzard Announces Name Reservation Issue for Oceanic Players in WoW: Forever
items.summary: Blizzard has announced a name reservation issue for Oceanic Players who are connecting to Australian-based servers.

items.title: Join the WoW Portal Room for Your Next Adventure in WoW: Forever
items.summary: Blizzard has released a new blog, incentivizing players to join the WoW Portal Room!

items.title: Living Heartsbane Cauldron Mount Now Available on Battle.net Store
items.summary: The Living Heartsbane Cauldron is available on the Battle.net Store for $25!

items.title: Update: Name Reservations for WoW: Forever Now Live in EU, NA
items.summary: Updated: The delay on Forever name reservations is complete, and players can now reserve their names on EU and NA!

items.title: New Grimtide Housing Bundles Available for Hearthsteel
items.summary: New real-money bundles for Housing are available on the Battle.net Store: The Haunted Grimtide Estate and the Grimtide Decor pack.

items.title: World of Warcraft: Forever AMV - WARPATH
items.summary: To highlight the upcoming launch of WoW: Forever, Blizzard has released a brand new AMV called WARPATH!

items.title: [Updated] More Racial Ability Tuning on WoW: Forever
items.summary: Blizzard has added even more racial ability tuning in WoW: Forever, now also affecting Trolls.
